scope: Repair the optical reader on the already captured passive corner/face print. Development only, not a controller, a holdout, a new trajectory, or a substitute for the 70-degree co-visible tool/endpoint test.
geometry: Keep the original cap-to-vertex physical bound. A cap is NOT its centroid. At an interior ordinal look for the cap directly adjoining the shared boundary between the two successive row inks on the same bank. On a locally visible continuous piece of that transverse material edge, the corner lies on the continuation of the observed boundary. Use only the short connected, straight, depth-continuous segment adjoining the cap. Intersect its finite-width continuation strip with the old bound, retaining uncertainty in the direction as well as the offset. Refuse ambiguity/multiple components, bends or lack of support; never make an unseen edge exact. This is an image-conditioned edge correspondence, not a proof that all folded/occluded sheets have this correspondence. Check projected containment of EVERY returned corner region independently in the saved dataset; one miss disqualifies this geometry for integration. No true vertices, poses, phase, action count or lengths enter the reader.
face: For each available triangle require the entire sensor pixel footprint to be interior under its three corner regions; a connected 2x2 block of finite depth >2 mm beyond the farthest corner bound, with depth uncertainty, is positive absence. Opaque foreground and missing ink cannot certify OPEN. Connected, physically supported face ink certifies PRESENT. A lone unrelated colour elsewhere or at through-depth is not a material veto; a depth-supported contradiction within the feasible face remains unresolved. Missing local corners affect their own faces, not the entire frame.
terminal_geometry: The first synthetic pass (cell_v2_synthetic_dev_01) correctly returned local progress but could not prove a prefix: row 0 has no previous bank colour. At rows 0 and 13 only, accept a straight transverse end visible against positive deep background on the outward side of the cap, with both end caps actually visible to distinguish it from the longitudinal lip. Keep the same cap/line uncertainty and demand the originally registered outcomes. No real replay results were used for this implementation correction.
output: Always distinguish local_mm (unique visible OPEN/OPEN row followed by a resolved non-fully-open row and positive intact material beyond, no visible intervening bridge or later openings) from prefix/decision (all preceding rows positively open and observed connected). Missing upstream proof leaves decision UNKNOWN, even if local_mm is available. No action API. Uncut, ambiguity, a visible earlier bridge, target occlusion, or a beyond-budget front must not produce a misleading stop.
synthetic: Validate 0, 3, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11 open rows, either half of the threshold cell remaining, interior bridge, target shutter, complete shutter, isolated colour at remote and through-depth locations, depth-supported competing ink, hidden entry and missing distant corner; also a slanted/transversely sheared raster at approximately 27 px per row, with the three-way printed cap/row contacts. Verify that geometry has nonempty robust area and encloses known projected vertices. Raw and 0.5 mm depth noise; no unexpected lower progress or STOP.
data: Replay ALL high RGB-D archives under seam_rim_zoom_v1/asym/{pull,a,b,c,d,e}, seam_rim_near_v1/asym/near and seam_rim_look_v1/{near,b,c}. Actual 20-degree 2560x1920 camera. Raw and per-image seeded 0.5 mm noise; repeated physical checkpoints are not independent evidence. Also test the differently printed wide development work/look samples as incompatible-ink negatives. Seal blind results and input hashes before joining mechanical manifests or exact projected corners. Count work, backoff, park, uncut separately. No terminal score inferred from park.
gate: Require all registered cases/files, hashes, synthetic controls, zero incorrect positive face/local/prefix claims and zero escaped corner bounds in both variants. All terminal work/backoff images must give exact local progress (<0.5 mm); report the stricter contiguous-prefix decision separately. Verify recovered nonempty geometries vs v1 on the same real frames. Failure does not alter signed gates. Native wide-field samples with just side inks must abstain. No confirmation or closed-loop runs on a failed or incompatible optical configuration.
